title: parse() warnings Vec: no documented guarantee on warning count or stability
description: ParsedMessage::warnings: Vec<String> is returned by mime-tree::parse(). The strings are human-readable but their content is not documented as stable. What goes wrong: callers who inspect warning strings to detect specific conditions (e.g. 'missing Content-Type header') will break when the warning text changes, even within a minor version. There is no way to programmatically distinguish 'has warnings about encoding' from 'has warnings about structure'. The fix is to either: (a) make warnings an opaque Vec<Warning> where Warning is a #[non_exhaustive] enum with machine-readable variants and a Display impl for human text; or (b) document that warning strings are not stable and callers must not pattern-match on them. File: mime-tree/src/message.rs.
